The condition of possibility for the recent rapprocement between China and Tawan lies in the depoliticization of economic relations.

the social relations of transnational production in the context of the Chinese state s economic reform and its implications for the political and social order in Taiwan.
the question, in what terms and to what extent has the transnationalisation of China Taiwan relations been successful?
the question, how a hegemonic project of transnational integration is able to forge a seemingly natural order of things, which is in reality a contested order.

the transnationalisation of China Taiwan relations has led to an increasing de politicalisation of economic relations and the emergence of a transnational civil society.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the apparent separation of China Taiwan civil society relations from the political level of state relations is a contingent outcome of the specific trans national project that has been forged.
